message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., Family Day in Ontario, British Columbia, etc.—you’ll have to add those separately.)

| Holiday | Date 2023 | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span (inclusive) |
|---------|-----------|-------------|--------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Jan 1 – 3 (Sunday – Tuesday) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Apr 7 – 9 (Friday – Sunday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | May 20 – 22 (Saturday – Monday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Jun 30 – Jul 2 (Friday – Sunday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Sep 2 – 4 (Saturday – Monday) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | Oct 7 – 9 (Saturday – Monday) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Friday | Nov 11 – 13 (Friday – Sunday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | Dec 23 – 25 (Saturday – Monday) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | Dec 26 – 28 (Tuesday – Thursday) |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a simple array or database table.  
2. **Mark the entire span** as a “long weekend” so users can filter or highlight it.  
3. If you want to support province‑specific holidays, add a second table keyed by province and merge the results.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same list for another year or for a specific province!
